title: [review] stack.rs: Integer truncation in RPL source routing header le
description: The Hdr Ext Len field is computed as `(routing_len / 8 - 1) as u8`. For routes with remaining > 127 hops, this truncates incorrectly. With remaining=128, Hdr Ext Len should be 256 but is truncated to 0. Line 660 checks `remaining > 255` but should check `remaining > 127` to prevent silent corruption of source routing headers.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed remaining check from >255 to >127 to prevent Hdr Ext Len (2*remaining) truncation when cast to u8
